odd_high_ancestor.proof: An odd/high output forces count0 on every left/right shift on its value-operand ancestor chain. Initial/T-only ancestors have equal low2 on the pair, while target bit1 differs.

order_partition.no_shifts: At most two non-final comparisons split the common low16 class at most four ways. MAD and bit operations do not split a class; eight distinct target low16 values are required.
order_partition.CST/SCT_literal_right: A final MAD using both a Boolean c and a literal initial-word right shift q is one of six recorded forms. All nine times33 source/count cases are excluded. XOR/OR preserve q bits>=1; AND is <=1. Dead comparisons or dead shifts reduce to the prior core.
order_partition.CST_boolean_amount: A comparison count is0/1. For an initial-word right-shift datum, count0 gives one low16 class; count1 gives at most two by the recorded low17 counts, at most three (c,q) classes total. A left shift gives at most two classes. Constant/Boolean data give at most two. Eight distinct outputs are impossible.
order_partition.CST/SCT_initial_amount: Every initial-word amount is>=32 at all eight recorded inputs. Either shift produces0, so the remaining Boolean and initial words yield at most two low16 outputs.
order_partition.CST/SCT_literal_left: A prepared-constant left shift normalizes to a T operation. With one comparison, low16 can split at most two ways.
order_partition.CTS/TCS: Before the final shift, the value datum has at most two low16 classes. A high target requires final right-shift count0 at four distinct low16 targets; an odd target requires final left-shift count0 at four distinct low16 targets. Both contradict the two-class bound.
order_partition.CSS/SCS: On the prior odd/high ancestor pair, every shift on the value-operand chain has count0. Initial/root-constant ancestors have equal low2 but targets differ at bit1. A Boolean ancestor cannot be high. This also covers two comparisons plus one final shift.
order_partition.final_C: A final comparison returns0/1, whereas all recorded targets are>1.
order_partition.two_C_one_T: Two Boolean results give at most four low16 states to the final T, fewer than eight target states.

scope: At most3 straight-line uint32 MAD/XOR/AND/OR/SHL/SHR/< /== operations, nine stated live words, arbitrary root-only constants and arbitrary shift/comparison operands. Comparisons relaxed to arbitrary Boolean per input. ADD/SUB/MUL normalize to MAD. No DIV/REM/CDIV, vbroadcast, FLOW, memory, cross-lane, extra inputs or larger windows; no global kernel lower bound.
